description: This file is a Gatsby Node API implementation for a challenge-based curriculum, handling challenge node sourcing, page creation, and schema customization, with file watching for updates.

methods.name: createSchemaCustomization
methods.description: Defines custom GraphQL schema types for challenge questions.

methods.name: sourceNodes
methods.description: Sources challenge nodes from files, sets up file watchers for updates, and creates superblock structure nodes.

methods.name: createPagesStatefully
methods.description: Creates challenge pages with navigation links after fetching challenge data.

methods.name: createPages
methods.description: Creates challenge pages based on sourced nodes.
